security.title: Security
security.s1: Threads passwords are never stored. Login is strictly via official Meta OAuth.
security.s2: Your analytics and style documents are isolated from other users.
security.s3: Turn off automation or disconnect anytime with the Kill Switch, no middleman.

beta.title: Private beta, limited slots.
beta.desc: I am opening 25 slots so I can guide you directly and improve the product with you. During beta, core features are free. After that, it will be paid, with early-bird pricing for beta users.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.q1: Why do I need to request access?
faq.a1: Ixiera is in early access and the app is still in Meta developer mode. I manually add each account, so you need to be approved first. You will be notified via email.
faq.a2: During beta, core features are free for the first 25 users. After that, it will be paid.
faq.q3: Does it post without my permission?
faq.a3: No, unless you enable it. Replies have two modes: Manual Review and Full Auto. The Kill Switch stops everything at any time.
faq.a4: You can set hourly reply limits to comply with Meta API policies. The final decision rests with Meta, so start with a low limit.
faq.a5: Set the "Tone Prompt" in Settings. The AI is directed to be polite, concise, and match your style.
faq.q6: How is this different from a scheduler?
faq.a6: Schedulers just schedule. Ixiera learns from your account data to determine what, when, and how you post.
faq.a7: No. There is a step-by-step guide and a credit option with no API key required.
